page_title: LUT 1-1 NOT | Luton v Nottingham Forest 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Murillo (Nottingham). Darren England saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Luton get a free kick.

90+7' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Ryan Yates (Nottingham), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
90+6' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

90+6' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
90+5' Neco Williams (Nottingham) commits a foul and Darren England immediately signals a free kick.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle after Neco Williams (Nottingham) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
90+2' Ross Barkley (Luton) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

90+2' Issa Kabore (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Luton.
90' Matz Sels (Nottingham) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 1 GOAL - 1:1! The corner comes over and Reece Burke flicks on with his head to Luke Berry (Luton), who makes no mistake and fires the ball into the back of the net.
89' Ross Barkley (Luton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
89' Issa Kabore (Luton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Now Luton have a corner.
88' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
86' The resulting corner from Ross Barkley (Luton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
85' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Carlton Morris (Luton). The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Luton.

85' Ross Barkley (Luton) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
85' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Luke Berry (Luton) replaces Jordan Clark.
84' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
82' It is time for a substitution. Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) is on for Morgan Gibbs-White.
80' Luton keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
78' Thomas Kaminski comes off his line to intercept the corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham).

77' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Nottingham will have a chance to score from a corner.
77' The ball is cleared after Carlton Morris (Luton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
75' Felipe (Nottingham) comes onto the pitch because Chris Wood simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is coming onto the pitch as Divock Origi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
75' Chris Wood (Nottingham) picks up an injury.
74' Ross Barkley (Luton) brings his opponent down. Darren England has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
72' The resulting corner from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.

72' Neco Williams (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Nottingham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
70' Andros Townsend (Luton) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the top of the net, but Matz Sels is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
68' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

65' Great solo effort from Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
65' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
65' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Nottingham get a corner.
64' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

63' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

63' Murillo (Nottingham) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Thomas Kaminski was alert and made a comfortable save. Nottingham force their opponents to concede a corner.
60' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Andros Townsend (Luton) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
59' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
58' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
57' Ross Barkley (Luton) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
55' Murillo (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Luton.

54' Tahith Chong (Luton) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.

52' What a chance! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players makes a crucial goal-line clearance.
52' The ball rebounds to Jordan Clark (Luton) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.
51' The corner kick from Ross Barkley (Luton) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
50' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick.
49' Divock Origi (Nottingham) is penalised for a foul. Darren England had a clear view and blows his whistle.
49' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

46' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Thomas Kaminski inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
46' Rob Edwards has made a change at the break. Cauley Woodrow has come on in place of Alfie Doughty (Luton).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Ross Barkley (Luton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
45+1' The Luton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Alfie Doughty (Luton) attempts to send a cross in from the free kick but he can't find any of his teammates and the ball goes behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
43' Celebrations are cut short for Luton as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
42' The Luton players halt their celebrations as referee Darren England makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
42' Teden Mengi (Luton) fires the ball inside the back of the net!
41' Luton win a corner.
41' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
39' Luton will take a corner kick.
39' Tahith Chong (Luton) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
39' Neco Williams (Nottingham) swings it in and Chris Wood gets on the end of it, but Thomas Kaminski shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
37' Neat passing move from Nottingham in order to create new attacking opportunities.
34' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Morgan Gibbs-White plays it into the box, and Chris Wood (Nottingham) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the roof of the net. 0:1.
33' Divock Origi (Nottingham) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
31' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
31' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) will take a free kick. Is he going to strike the ball directly at the goal? Let's find out!
30' Issa Kabore (Luton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
30' Issa Kabore (Luton) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Nottingham have a free kick.
29' Darren England blows his whistle. Tahith Chong (Luton) commits a foul after dangerous play.
27' Luton hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
25' The Nottingham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
23' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

23' Good clearance! Chris Wood (Nottingham) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity.
22' Jordan Clark (Luton) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
21' Jordan Clark (Luton) serves up a nice cross, but Matz Sels punches the ball away.
20' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.

19' Morgan Gibbs-White finds the head of Willy Boly (Nottingham) with a clever free kick, and he crashes in a powerful close-range header at goal that just flies past the left post. Unlucky! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
19' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
18' Tahith Chong (Luton) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. Nottingham will take a free kick.
17' CHANCE! Morgan Gibbs-White finds Divock Origi (Nottingham) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
16' Jordan Clark (Luton) plays a one-two with Carlton Morris, but the move breaks down.
14' Darren England blows his whistle and it's Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

12' Ross Barkley (Luton) produces a great solo run in the middle of the field, zig-zags through the opposition's defence at full speed and fires a powerful strike that crashes against the right post. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
11' Ross Barkley (Luton) tries to find Alfie Doughty, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

10' Ross Barkley (Luton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Matz Sels!

9' Ross Barkley (Luton) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Matz Sels, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
6' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
6' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
3' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham).
3' Half-chance! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) plays a pass into the box, but Thomas Kaminski reacts well to snuff out the attack.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Darren England will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
